name: Tyetel Zanas
source:
"Even if I were to hate the whole world, you are the one person I don't want to lose."

Zanas started his career as TotES talent scout, until he decided to cast himself when he couldn't find anyone up to his sky-high standards. His fans idolize him, while the rest see him as an insufferable troll.

[From [url=https://herchoicevn.tumblr.com/tyetel-zanas]offiical bio[/url]]
